area: Career catalogue, rulebook version 15 (2026-11-24, stage130): round 15 'Over the Line', the week and the court. Full Week and its runs (The Line, a ring emblem), Court Hours, Match Day, Cross-Court, the weeks on court and the Ten-Hour Month (Court, a roundel), the cabinet's new section Moving, and the words on the emblems. 'Move minutes' is دقیقهٔ تحرک (28-whole-week.json). Formal (شما), as every new Farsi text since 2026-11-21. Drafts until Amir has read them. Also the crew's Over the Line card (#151): the week that went over 300 Move minutes, and what took it there. Also #152 Best Week Yet (the tag on Your weeks) and #155 Long Day (the word on a crew activity of two hours or more).
